title: Sandbox execution by default — always run agents in isolated environment
description: Container isolation via devcontainer is optional and off by default. Make agent sandboxing the default behavior: auto-create a lightweight Docker container per project (or use the existing devcontainer) and run all agent sessions inside it. This prevents agents from accidentally modifying host files outside the project.
competitiveContext: OpenHands runs all agents in Docker sandboxes by default. Devin has managed sandboxes. TeamAI's current opt-in devcontainer is a weaker security posture.
